answer: Bind every identity to a glacial forge: each epoch the beacon designates a zenith difficulty, and the agent must hammer out a proof whose hash begins with N leading zeros where N grows with the epoch number. The glacier audit freezes the difficulty curve for 6 epochs, so an attacker adding clones must re‑forge the entire chain from the glacier base, paying exponentially more per extra identity. A single honest miner pays once per epoch; a farm of N clones pays N times the zenith cost, making marginal profit negative after the second clone.
